method: Inclusion is every species printed under the Bovidae heading on the 2011 Wayback SANParks KNP mammal checklist PDF (22 species). English and Afrikaans names, and species order, are taken from that PDF. Scientific names are the 2011 names unless an iNaturalist taxon record cited in remaps gives a current name. Research-grade counts are for iNaturalist place_id 69020. iNaturalist-only bovids are in candidates, not species. The PDF was fetched to a temporary path for text extraction and was not copied into this project.

remaps.note: iNaturalist preferred_common_name for taxon 42280. Blue Wildebeest remains a listed English name on the same taxon. The stored en value is the 2011 SANParks checklist name.

An iNaturalist taxa search for the 2011 name matches species Alcelaphus buselaphus (taxon 42418), which lists Sigmoceros lichtensteinii as an invalid scientific name. The Kruger taxon is stored as the iNaturalist subspecies Alcelaphus buselaphus lichtensteinii (taxon 132659; preferred_common_name Lichtenstein's Hartebeest). That subspecies record also lists Alcelaphus lichtensteinii as an invalid scientific name. The research-grade count is the subspecies total (16), not the species-level total of 19, which includes 3 research-grade observations of A. b. caama.

gaps: Live SANParks checklist HTML and PDF were not fetched in this session (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403). Inclusion is the 2011 Wayback PDF only, and has not been compared with the live 147–148 figure.
iNaturalist checklist 8810 was not fetched (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403/401).

Four official-list species have 0 research-grade iNaturalist observations in place 69020: Cephalophorus natalensis (2 observations of any grade), Ourebia ourebi (1), Pelea capreolus (1), and Nesotragus moschatus (none of any grade in the place taxonomy tree). Absence of an iNat record was not treated as absence from KNP.
Redunca fulvorufula is on the official list but has only 1 research-grade iNaturalist observation in the place.

The iNaturalist species-level research-grade count for Alcelaphus buselaphus is 19, which mixes Lichtenstein's hartebeest (16) and red hartebeest A. b. caama (3). The included taxon uses the subspecies count.

The iNaturalist search for Sigmoceros lichtensteinii resolves to Alcelaphus buselaphus (the species), not directly to subspecies lichtensteinii. The subspecies was used because that is the iNaturalist taxon whose preferred common name is Lichtenstein's Hartebeest.

No rare, reintroduced, or introduced flags are recorded for official Bovidae species: the 2011 PDF does not mark any of them with an asterisk or other status note (asterisks on that list are only for house mouse and house/black rat under Muridae).
Candidate Afrikaans names were left null. The Phase 2 rule was to take af from the 2011 SANParks checklist; these taxa are not on that list.
The current live official list, Skinner & Chimimba, and Stuart's guide were not available to corroborate remaps or flags.
